description: This file defines an Android Service named AuthenticationService that handles account authentication by providing an Authenticator instance and returning its IBinder.

classes.name: AuthenticationService
classes.description: An Android Service that manages account authentication, creating an Authenticator instance and providing its binder.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the Authenticator when the service is created.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Logs when the service is stopped; can be extended for cleanup.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns the IBinder of the Authenticator for clients binding to the service.
